# Content B2 batch 62

## Scope and manual review

Added 25 CEFR A1-B1 entries through the authoring workflow:
atlantic, flavour, humour, judgement, jumper, memorise, minimise, moss,
motherland, motionless, motto, mountaintop, mourn, mule, myth, narrate,
nationalist, nectar, neutral, newcomer, next-door, nickname, nightlife,
noisily, nonetheless.

I manually reviewed every English definition, part of speech, example,
Vietnamese gloss, Vietnamese example, level, and topic. The two definitions
that initially exceeded the checker limit were shortened without changing
meaning (motto and mule). All 25 entries are silver.
